answer: The strongest single control I know for this is sign language interpreter certificate hash with deaf association attestation, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 704 aliases would need 704 separate proofs, each costing about 98 POA or 14 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The delta of the design is public, the ledge of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the harbor of honest work is what finally pays. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
